title: Package pr-reviewer in nix and migrate four manual LaunchAgents
intent: Declare pr-reviewer as a nix package (buildRustPackage pinned to upstream rev 4d27724, since upstream ships no flake and it is absent from nixpkgs) and add it as a nix-darwin LaunchAgent so it starts at login. Migrate four hand-written plists (com.dktaohan.foundry-proxy, com.lego.btsbox.devrel, com.lego.btsbox.devrel.serve, com.gascity.bd.companion) into modules/M-02877/darwin.nix launchd.user.agents, reading the btsbox external password from its token file rather than inlining it. Regenerate the four governed entrypoints for the installed Decapod release (0.99.11 -> 0.99.15) and record correct beads tracker metadata. RESOLVED during execution: cargoHash derived by building (sha256-XpFZLDgppAkIPmj95ihi5hkd+k5pgnKDa3c74xUJBuQ=); btsbox/bd/gasworks-companion keep absolute non-store paths because they are installed out of band; pr-reviewer's stale devrel-infra local_path needed no change, because concurrent sessions had already moved all three repos to managed clones, which is what auto_fix requires.
proof_hooks: nix build of pr-reviewer package succeeds with pinned cargoHash
darwin-rebuild build evaluates with all five agents declared
launchctl list shows the five labels after switch
